conventions.keys: Unity Keyframe fields. time in seconds, slopes in value/second. Evaluate a segment k0->k1 (dt = t1 - t0) as a cubic Hermite with m0 = k0.outSlope*dt and m1 = k1.inSlope*dt (weightedMode 0 = unweighted, which is every key here). "Infinity" as a slope means a stepped (constant) segment: hold k0.value until t1.
conventions.tangentMode: packed int: bit0 = broken, bits1-4 = left mode, bits5-8 = right mode; mode 0 Free, 1 Auto, 2 Linear, 3 Constant, 4 ClampedAuto. 136 = ClampedAuto both sides (smooth, flat at extremes), 69 = broken Linear/Linear. The slopes are already baked, so tangentMode is informational.
conventions.curves: path is relative to the GameObject carrying the Animator ("" = that object). component names the animated component (RectTransform, Image, CanvasGroup, GameObject...). attribute examples: m_AnchoredPosition.x, m_SizeDelta.y, m_LocalScale.x, m_LocalRotation.z (quaternion component), m_Color.a, m_FillAmount, m_IsActive, m_Alpha. Curves come from m_EditorCurves (per-float) when present.
conventions.pre_postInfinity: Unity curve wrap (2 = clamp, the default for every curve here). Whether a clip repeats is the clip loop flag.
conventions.controllers: Every state here has writeDefaults=true: a state whose clip does not animate a property restores that property to its authored (scene) value. Transitions with conditions on Trigger parameters are fired by Button "Animation" transitions (trigger names in the node's button.animationTriggers) or by code (SetTrigger). Empty conditions + hasExitTime=false never occur here. An Animator restarts at the layer defaultState every time its GameObject is enabled (keepStateOnDisable=false).
